[/s]A seasonal medieval retexture of Inmognito's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12459]Tiny Greenhouse for Solid Foundations[/url] mod with an animated (also seasonal) interior backdrop.
Both the interior backdrop and exterior will change automatically each new season.

This is a standalone building separate from the regular larger greenhouse that comes with the farm, and is purchasable from Robin after the player reaches [b][color=#d9ead3]Farming lvl 4[/color][/b].

The greenhouse has more accurate ambience lighting compared to vanilla buildings and will become slightly dark inside when it is raining outside, and very dark inside when it is night time unless there are light sources placed inside. 🌧🌙🔆

[b][u][color=#ea9999]The original Tiny Greenhouse for Solid Foundations mod is still required[/color][/u][/b] for this mod to work, so make sure you download it!
[i](and all other mods required by the original!)

The mod will detect what recolour you have installed and apply it automatically for both the exterior and interior.
You can also manually change the recolour options for the [i]interior only[/i] in the config options if you wish.

If you use the [b]Light[/b] theme option with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url], you will need to [i]manually[/i] change the Glass Frame color and the Flooring color to Light.

[size=3]💧 [color=#9fc5e8][b]The waterbin can also be disabled[/b] [/color]💧[/size]

You can manually change the interior options using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or opening and editing the config.json file that generates in the mod folder after first launch of the game when the mod is installed.
If you decide to change your options through the config.json, please see the Readme file included in the mod folder or this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1590]Article[/url]﻿﻿ for config option names.
